# ECA Cart

Electric cargo transport vehicle.

- ECA Cart

###### Electric cargo transport vehicle that makes the work of recyclers easier

People who work collecting recyclable materials lack the optimal tools to perform their daily tasks. To reduce risks, improve working conditions, and enhance the quality of life for recyclers, ECA was created in 2011: an electric cargo transport vehicle, similar to a conventional cart.

In collaboration with the Grupo Familia Foundation, EAFIT University has been conducting pilot tests with the Planeta Verde Cooperative in Rionegro since 2015. These pilot tests and research processes demonstrated a positive impact on the work of the waste pickers. Productivity increased by an average of 110% daily, as the weight of recyclable materials increased from 49 kg to 103 kg with the use of ECA (Electronic Collection Agent). This also represents a considerable increase in their income.

In 2017, the patent for this development was obtained, and recently, seeking to maximize its social and environmental impact, both institutions decided to make the knowledge behind this invention publicly available.

###### Patent released

EAFIT University, in its commitment to society and the strengthening of the circular economy, has decided to release the invention patent for the ECA Cart No. 14100205, a technological development designed to improve the working conditions of informal recyclers.

This release allows any person, company, or organization to access the information, structure, elements, and parts that make up the cart, facilitating its manufacture and adoption in different contexts. Its ergonomic and motorized design aims to reduce the physical effort of recyclers, optimize material collection, and promote the use of sustainable technologies in waste management.

[See the technology package here.](https://forms.office.com/r/BZV9VNAxa0)

#### **Applications**

Freight transport

Construction sector

Retail

Logistics

Recycling

#### **Benefits**

Its design allows adaptation to different usage situations and contexts.

Transport of up to 500 kilos of material.

It minimizes physical effort and increases productivity.

It facilitates the mobility and movement of cargo workers.

Improves biomechanical and occupational health conditions.

With 2.3 KW (which represents around $940) its 4 batteries are fully charged, allowing continuous operation for 6 to 8 hours.

**Contacto, mercadeo y promoción de la oferta académica**

Contactar al titular por correo electrónico, teléfono, mensajes de texto, WhatsApp u otros canales digitales para brindar asesoría, hacer seguimiento a solicitudes o inscripciones no culminadas, remitir información comercial y publicitaria sobre la oferta académica, eventos, becas y descuentos, y aplicar encuestas de satisfacción y estudios de mercado.

**Transmisión y transferencia de datos**

Compartir los datos con encargados, proveedores tecnológicos y aliados académicos, nacionales o internacionales, que apoyen los procesos de inscripción, pago, comunicación y desarrollo de los programas, quienes los tratarán únicamente conforme a las finalidades aquí autorizadas.

Estos derechos pueden ejercerse a través del correo [**datospersonales@eafit.edu.co**](mailto:datospersonales@eafit.edu.co). Esta autorización se mantendrá vigente mientras subsista la relación con la Universidad y, con posterioridad, durante el término necesario para atender obligaciones legales, contables, contractuales y de archivo, o hasta que el titular la revoque por el canal aquí indicado.
